sections.ingredients:
10 g fine powder of each of:- 

 Ginger Rhizome – Zingiber officinalis 
 Black pepper – Piper nigrum 
 Shuddha Parada – Purified Mercury 
 Shuddha Gandhaka – Purified Sulphur 
 Tankana Bhasma – Borax 
 Shuddha Jayapala – Croton tiglium – 30 g

 Fine powder of above ingredients is grounded with the juice extract, made into paste and pills are prepared.
sections.dosage:
Take 250 mg before or after food or as directed by Ayurvedic doctor. It is traditionally administered along with cold water. 
 After taking this medicine, patient is advised to take rice with buttermilk.
sections.side_effects:
Self-medication with this medicine may prove to be dangerous, as it contains Mercury as ingredient. 
 Take this medicine in precise dose and for limited period of time, as advised by doctor. 
 Over-dosage of this medicine cause severe poisonous effect and diarrhea. 
 This medicine should be strictly avoided during pregnancy, lactation and in children. 
 Keep out of reach and sight of children. 
 Store in a dry cool place. 


 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.

fullContent:
Ichhabhedi Rasa – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage 
 Reference: Bhaishajya Ratnavali Udara Rogadhikara 13 – 105 
 Ichhabhedi Rasa is an Ayurvedic medicine in tablet form. It is used in the treatment of ascites, constipation and bloating. This medicine induces the purgation. This medicine should be taken strictly only under medical supervision as it contains heavy metal ingredient. 
 Ingredients 
 10 g fine powder of each of:- 
 
 Ginger Rhizome – Zingiber officinalis 
 Black pepper – Piper nigrum 
 Shuddha Parada – Purified Mercury 
 Shuddha Gandhaka – Purified Sulphur 
 Tankana Bhasma – Borax 
 Shuddha Jayapala – Croton tiglium – 30 g 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 Fine powder of above ingredients is grounded with the juice extract, made into paste and pills are prepared. 
 Indications 
 
 Ascites 
 Constipation 
 Bloating 
 
 Dosage 
 
 Take 250 mg before or after food or as directed by Ayurvedic doctor. It is traditionally administered along with cold water. 
 After taking this medicine, patient is advised to take rice with buttermilk. 
 
 Side Effects 
 
 Self-medication with this medicine may prove to be dangerous, as it contains Mercury as ingredient. 
 Take this medicine in precise dose and for limited period of time, as advised by doctor. 
 Over-dosage of this medicine cause severe poisonous effect and diarrhea. 
 This medicine should be strictly avoided during pregnancy, lactation and in children. 
 Keep out of reach and sight of children. 
 Store in a dry cool place. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
